newsitem.title: UK: Brit Biotech says Japan cancer link close.
newsitem.headline: Brit Biotech says Japan cancer link close.

text.p: British Biotech Plc said on Monday it expected to announce details of a Japanese partnership for its cancer drug Marimastat "in the next couple of months."
In a telephone interview with Reuters after the announcement of further trial data on Marimastat, finance director James Noble said talks with a Japanese company were at an advanced stage.
British Biotech plans to sell Marimastat, which is still at least three years away from approval, by itself in most countries, but regards Japan as a tricky market in which to go it alone.
Noble said the prospect of a collaboration would be enhanced by data published earlier on Monday showing the impact of Marimastat on gastric cancer, which is one of the biggest cancers in Japan.
